theorem exStep_length (N : Network ℕ) (U : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (st : ℕ × ℕ × List ℕ) (L : List ℕ) :
    (exStep N U st L).2.2.length ≤ st.2.2.length + 1 := by
  unfold exStep
  split
  · split <;> simp
  · split
    · split <;> simp
    · simp
